common.needHelpHub: Need help? Ask any officer, or call {phone}.
common.decisionsNote: Decisions on applications are made by the government authority.
common.toggleTheme: Switch between light and dark theme

landing.heroTitle: Government services, finished in one visit.
landing.heroBody: Walk in to any hub, or book a time to skip the wait. An officer completes the application for you, you pay once, and we send you a link to follow it until it is ready to collect.
landing.servicesBody: What each one costs and how long it usually takes. You see the documents to bring when you book.
landing.how1Body: Come to any hub during opening hours. To skip the wait, book a time online and get a booking code.
landing.how2Body: An officer checks you in, screens your documents and completes the application for you.
landing.how3Body: One payment by M-Pesa or card covers everything. Hubs do not take cash.
landing.how4Body: We email and text you a link. It opens your application so you can follow every step until collection.
landing.hubsBody: Every hub is accredited, and each offers the services it is certified for.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Choose what describes you. It decides which identity document we ask for next.
account.citizenHint: You register with your national ID number
account.residentHint: You register with your foreigner certificate number
account.otherHint: No national ID or foreigner certificate. You register with your passport
account.detailsBody: Enter the details exactly as they appear on your document.
account.contactBody: We send your booking codes and application updates here.
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a number.
account.agree: I agree to the terms of use and the privacy notice.
account.signInBody: Use the phone number or email you registered with.
account.passwordRule: Use at least 8 characters, with a number
account.mustAgree: You need to agree to continue
account.createdBody: Sign in with the phone number or email and the password you just set.

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.body: Choose a service, a hub and a time.
booking.noTimes: No times left on this day. Try another date.
booking.accountNeeded: You need an account to book ahead. Walking in instead? No account or booking is needed.
booking.chooseService: Choose a service to see what to bring.
booking.day2: Show your booking code or passport to the officer at the entrance
booking.keepCopy: Your ticket is in your email. You can also keep a copy on this device.

application.title: My application
application.subtitle: {service}, reference {reference}. We message you each time something changes.
application.nothingNeeded: Nothing is needed from you right now.
application.noneBody: An application is submitted during your hub visit, with or without a booking. After that, this page shows every step until your document is ready to collect.
application.docNeededBody: The authority has asked a question about your application. You do not need to visit the hub.
application.uploadAlt: Or bring it to reception at the hub
application.uploaded: Thank you. Your document was sent to the hub.
application.notFoundTitle: We could not find that application
application.notFoundBody: Check the link in your SMS or email, or call {phone}.
application.signInTitle: Sign in to see your application
application.signInBody: Your applications and appointments appear here once you sign in.

welcome.title: Karibu. Welcome.
welcome.body: Choose how we can help you today. Your ticket prints below the screen.
welcome.generalBody: National ID, birth certificates, business names and other services.
welcome.priorityBody: An assisted desk with a lowered counter, and a shorter wait.
welcome.executiveBody: Foreign investors and corporate applications, in a private suite.
welcome.bookedHint: Scan their booking code or passport on the reader.
welcome.tapHint: Tap a stream for the client, then log the visit.

visitLogged.title: Screening done, your visit is logged
visitLogged.nextBody: Straight ahead. An officer checks your documents and gives you a queue ticket.
visitLogged.queueHint: This decides which counter calls you

documents.completeBody: The reception officer has checked what you brought against the checklist.
documents.missingBody: Please bring it and come back to reception. You keep your place for today.
documents.nextTitle: We give you a queue ticket
documents.nextBody: Then take a seat until your number is called.

ticket.title: Your queue ticket
ticket.body: Take a seat. Your number appears on the screen and is read aloud when a counter is ready.
ticket.ahead: {count, plural, =0 {You are next} one {# person ahead of you} other {# people ahead of you}}
ticket.sms: We will also text you when you are called.

checkDetails.title: Please check your details
checkDetails.body: {officer} has typed your application. Read each part and tell them if anything is wrong.

consent.title: Consent and signature
consent.body: We need your permission to use your details for this application.
consent.agree: I give my consent to data processing

captured.title: Your passport and documents are captured
captured.body: The passport was read by machine, so nothing was typed by hand. Each scan is saved under your reference {reference}.
captured.originalsNote: Please check you have your originals back. Your passport stays with the officer until the lodgement step.

biometrics.title: Your photo and fingerprints
biometrics.body: Look at the camera, then place each finger on the reader when the officer asks.
biometrics.doneBody: Everything was captured to the government standard.
biometrics.wipeHint: Wipe your finger dry, then press it flat on the glass and hold still.
biometrics.nextBody: One payment covers everything and you get one receipt.

payment.title: Pay for your application
payment.body: One total, paid once. Choose how you want to pay.
payment.feeNote: Includes the statutory fee and the hub service charge.
payment.phone: M-Pesa phone number, entered by the officer
payment.checkPhone: Check your phone. Enter your M-Pesa PIN to pay {amount}.
payment.footnote: We do not take cash. Your application cannot be submitted until the payment is confirmed.

paymentConfirmed.title: Payment confirmed
paymentConfirmed.body: Thank you. One receipt covers everything and we have emailed you a copy.

lodgement.title: Your passport is lodged
lodgement.body: Your passport stays safely in the hub vault while the authority processes your application. Keep this receipt.

submitted.title: Your application is submitted
submitted.body: Keep this acknowledgement. We will text and email you a link to follow your application.
submitted.nextBody: There is nothing more to do today. We contact you if the authority needs anything.

collection.title: Collect your passport and permit
collection.body: Your passport has been taken out of the vault and the permit is now inside it.
collection.sign: Sign to confirm you received your passport
collection.signNote: Please open your passport and check the permit before you sign.

feedback.title: How was your visit?
feedback.body: Your rating goes to the hub manager. It takes a few seconds.
feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your case is closed. Safe journey.
